caption: The video captures a tall transparent drinking glass filled with clear water, resting centered on a rounded metallic pedestal against a smooth dark-blue gradient backdrop. A single irregular ice cube floats suspended just beneath the waterline, its upper edge breaking the surface while a frosted white mass clings to its lower end. The cube holds roughly the same vertical position throughout, neither sinking nor rising, as trapped air bubbles and the pale tip shift subtly over time. The internal texture churns faintly, consistent with slow melting, and the long axis of the ice drifts only marginally in orientation. In the first half, a small round bubble appears at the right side of the cube, lingering briefly before fading. The water surface, the rim of the glass, and the pedestal stay fixed, with only a soft flicker of light moving across the background. The melting continues without resolution to the end.
